original_post_text:
Shoutout to TCH Dallas for adding PLO Madness to the rotation and shoutout to the PLO tournament lovers for showing out.

187 entries. $46,750 prize pool. On a $30K GTD. The players decided that one.

I went deep and finished 18th but I honestly left a lot on the felt. Had a hand where I was a favorite that would've made me chip leader. I couldn’t hold. That hurt.

But the bigger story is what TCH is doing right. More formats. More guarantees. More ways to compete. This is how you continue to build a scene.

Back at it May 24th. Who's playing?

expanded_body:
Originally posted May 4, 2026.

Shoutout to Texas Card House Dallas for adding PLO Madness to the tournament rotation, and shoutout to the Pot-Limit Omaha tournament lovers across DFW for showing out.

The numbers tell the story:
• Event: TCH Dallas PLO Madness ($30,000 GTD, $300 buy-in)
• Field: 187 entries
• Final prize pool: $46,750

On a $30K guarantee, the players decided that one.

I went deep and finished 18th, though I honestly left a lot on the felt. Late in the tournament I had a hand where I got it in as a favorite in a pot that would have made me chip leader — and couldn't hold. That hurt.

But the bigger story is what TCH Dallas is doing right: more formats, more guarantees, and more ways to compete. That is how you continue to build a scene.

Back at it for the next PLO Madness on May 24. Who's playing?

— Sham
author: Shomari Williams
